chapter: Rene, Whitney Bank and early life
title: Kid Rene's pupils and bass-playing with Rene
summary: Sharkey learned from Rene; Dawson played bass with Rene, with breakups, and hears of Simon Marrero and bazooka bands.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
